new.n: Recluse's $4,500 iron box in the cellar, S. 22nd Street, Sheboygan
new.pl: S. 22nd Street, Sheboygan (1930 papers); house number unknown, circle covers the length of the street
new.v: About $4,500 in gold and silver in an iron box (claimed)
new.st: An aged recluse was found dead in his kitchen in Feb 1930. In April an anonymous neighbour's letter told the sheriff he never banked his money but buried about $4,500 in gold and silver in an iron box in the cellar floor; lights had been seen in the basement at midnight. Only small sums turned up in a trunk, desk and cabinets, and the estate closed in Dec 1930 with no find reported. Urban lot: look-only. Pin is approximate, not the spot itself.
new.t: Urban lot: look-only. A 1930 city directory would give the house number.
pinev: Street-level: the 1930 papers give S. 22nd Street; house number unknown, so the circle covers the length of the street (about 2 km).
